verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents seller discovery through its MCP server and a Directory of services, and sellers attach pricing when they register a service, so some offer data exists on the platform. The docs never show a machine-readable offer payload that a developer can read for any listing. missing for 10: documented machine-readable price fields returned via API/MCP, availability data, variants, checkout links, a published offer schema or OpenAPI spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: The **Skyfire MCP server** enables agents to: Discover sellers
Click **Create Service** and provide details like: name, type, pricing, identity requirements, etc.
Browse the **Directory** to find services your agent can access programmatically.
